result.instructions: Tools for Simplicate, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which organizations did we add this month?"; "Show me the open sales deals and their expected values."; "Which invoices are still unpaid, and how old are they?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Simplicate data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run simplicate_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run simplicate_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run simplicate_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. simplicate_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: simplicate_list_organizations
tools.title: List organizations
tools.description: List CRM organizations (companies) with optional filters, e.g. filters {"name": "Acme*"}. Simplicate API: GET /api/v2/crm/organization.

filters.description: Field filters, e.g. {"name": "Acme*"}. Use * as a wildcard and null for empty values. Sent as q[field]=value.

select.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. id,name,email.

sort.description: Sort fields, comma-separated. Prefix - for descending, e.g. -name.
